text: The GS Yuasa brand on the Honda HRC Castrol bike is that of GS Yuasa Corporation of Kyoto (its sponsors-page entry links to gs-yuasa.com); GS Yuasa Corporation's own corporate profile states it is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
short: GS Yuasa is GS Yuasa Corporation of Kyoto, listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange prime market.

source.name: GS Yuasa Corporation - Corporate Profile
source.quote: Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
